digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation system with relationship pinning and execution-phase enforcement
propositions: Plan-review attestations remain valid after upstream plan-material changes in direct children or prerequisites, creating stale assumptions in dependent work.
New plan reviews must sign deterministic manifest lines binding each direct child and prerequisite's canonical ID, role, and current material fingerprint to detect drift at read time.
Tickets entering in_progress establish execution phase with a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold; compatible execution reviews require readings at or above this floor.
When enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, material drift in any pinned prerequisite or child invalidates the downstream attestation; when disabled, drift is visible but advisory.

Close operations require a current certified plan review when require_plan_review_for_close is enabled, using the same pin-aware validity checks as claim but intentionally ignoring file dependency hashes.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation deterministically returns one coverage record per pinned prerequisite with disposition consistent, finding, or indeterminate; any indeterminate makes the entire review unsigned.
